items.t: Trump offering $1M for voter fraud tips
items.x: Prosecuted cases of illegal voting or fraud committed by immigrants who do not have the right to vote remain rare, statistics show.

items.t: 'Who am I tipping here?' Self-service kiosk at airport prompts customer to tip 18%, viral video shows
items.x: The airport authority has since responded to the video, claiming the kiosk operator should not have been soliciting tips.

items.t: St. Petersburg police K-9 Diesel prepares for Game 4 at Tropicana Field
items.x: ST. PETERSBURG, Fla. (WFLA) — Game day security is back in full swing as the Tampa Bay Rays take on the Milwaukee Brewers in a must-win Game 4 of the World Series at Tropicana Field. St. Petersburg police officer Blomgren and K-9 Diesel…

items.t: Student, driver hospitalized after school bus crash in Dover: Hillsborough sheriff
items.x: Two people were hospitalized after a car struck a school bus in Dover on Tuesday morning, the Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office said.

items.t: 4 arrested after vehicle crashes into embankment during Hillsborough pursuit: HCSO
items.x: Four people were arrested after a driver fled from deputies toward a construction zone and crashed into an embankment near Interstate 75 and U.S. Highway 301, according to the Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office.

items.t: Halloween sticker shock has consumers planning to spend less
items.x: The scariest part of Halloween may be the price tag. A new survey finds 67% of U.S. consumers believe the holiday has become too expensive.

items.t: Tampa BBQ restaurant to be featured on Guy Fieri's 'Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives'
items.x: A Tampa barbecue restaurant announced Monday that it will be featured on the current season of Guy Fieri's "Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives."

items.t: World Series ticket prices have surged 275% in the past decade, new research shows
items.x: Researchers with Hard Rock Bet found that prices for U.S. sporting events have risen from $800 to $3,000 since 2015.

items.t: 2 men charged with UK national security offenses over incident at US-run military base in England
items.x: Two men were charged Tuesday with national security offenses over a suspected plot against RAF Fairford, a U.S.-run military air base in England, police and prosecutors said.

items.t: Starbucks announces 2026 Red Cup Day: Here’s when to get a free cup
items.x: According to the coffee chain, the tradition will return on Tuesday, November 17. Customers will receive a free, limited-edition reusable red holiday cup with the purchase of a seasonal beverage.

items.t: FBI searches Beverly Hills mansion tied to former Rep. Eric Swalwell
items.x: The FBI searched a Beverly Hills mansion in connection with an investigation into former Rep. Eric Swalwell, according to two people familiar with the probe.

items.t: HART bus driver cited in 3-vehicle crash that injured Tampa police officer
items.x: The crash caused a Tampa police cruiser to overturn, injuring an officer.

items.t: Ashley Moody, Angie Nixon offer Florida voters different visions for U.S. Senate
items.x: Republican Sen. Ashley Moody and Democratic challenger Angie Nixon agree that affordability is a concern for Florida families. But they offer sharply different ideas about how the federal government should respond.

items.t: Florida racketeering charges filed after $2.1M Sinaloa Cartel cocaine bust
items.x: Florida has announced additional charges after law enforcement officers dismantled one of the largest drug trafficking rings in Tampa Bay history after an investigation linked a local cocaine operation directly to the Sinaloa cartel.

items.t: 4 arrested after Hillsborough County pursuit ends in separate crashes on I-75, injuring deputy
items.x: Deputies say they found drugs in the car after the crash on Oct. 19.

items.t: Hulk Hogan's home sells for $5.9 million as daughter blasts 'fake, greedy people' involved
items.x: The home of former wrestler Hulk Hogan has sold for $5.9 million a year after his death after going through several major price cuts.

items.t: Susan Saint James, Emmy-winning actor of 'McMillan & Wife' and 'Kate & Allie,' dies at 80
items.x: Susan Saint James, known for her roles in “McMillan & Wife” and “Kate & Allie,” has died at 80.

items.t: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders sue My Chemical Romance
items.x: The legal dispute stems from the band's opening-night performance on Oct. 21, when backup dancers appeared onstage wearing outfits resembling the cheerleaders' signature blue-and-white uniforms during the group's 2006 hit "Teenagers."

items.t: Student injured in Dover school bus crash: HCSO
items.x: A student was injured in a school bus crash in Dover on Tuesday morning, the Hillsborough County Sheriff's Office said.

items.t: Claude AI reportedly bypassed paywall to access Georgia voter data
items.x: The model reportedly bypassed a paywall to retrieve aggregate vote counts but didn't access individual voter records.
